notes: insightLadder: FY27 Insight rate card by NO OF DEP (generic, MAP FY27 RC rounded to nearest 100). Rep/Man columns = 10%/15% off the rounded price (25%/30% if the RULES band selector = Band C; RULES!D22 is blank in the workbook so 10%/15% currently apply). The workbook ladder visually continues past 51 dep via the same lookup; full curves are in insightVolCurve (CI to 293 dep, CMI to 300 dep).
Firm-specific NB Insight price = volCurve(dep) * 1.05 * inf * 1.04 * 1.05, rounded to nearest 100, where inf comes from firm-rates.json (guide uplift + research/ranked ratio pct).

overview.bandDiscountRule: OVERVIEWS!D9 =IF(band="Band A",10%,20%); discounted price = fullRate * (1 - pct); country -> band via countryBands
overview.renewalNote: OVERVIEWS RENEWALS: 8% recommended price increase with authority down to 5% increase
overview.nbNote: OVERVIEWS NEW BUSINESS: rate card subject to country band discounts
overview.gap: UK BAR has no Country-level overview rate in the workbook (blank cell)

countryBandDefault.note: RATE CARD L19/M19 default when country not found

renewalRepLever.meaning: Rep discount on renewals = 20% off the pitch uplift: rep = base*(1+0.8*upliftPct), round to nearest 100 (RATE CARD K2, formula L4)

renewalManagerLever.meaning: Manager discount on renewals = 30% off the pitch uplift: manager = base*(1+0.7*upliftPct) (formula M4)

nbDisc.meaning: New business: rep price = pitch*(1-countryBand.nbRepDisc), manager = pitch*(1-nbManDisc), round to nearest 100

maxPrice.renewal: MAX = 2026 platform price * (1 + PLATFORM ONLY uplift), round to nearest 100
maxPrice.nb: MAX = NB pitch * 1.2 (Insight MAX is not re-rounded, e.g. 3700 -> 4440)

mydYear2UpliftPct.meaning: Multi-year deal year 2 = year-1 sales order * 1.08 (RATE CARD O2)

insightRenewalLikeForLike.meaning: Insight renewal at same dep count: price = 2026 insight spend * (1+pct); rep/manager = pitch (no extra discount); MAX = pitch*1.2. High risk = no 2025 insight spend but 2026 insight deps.

scenarioMultipliers.PLATFORM & ANALYTICS: flat if no 2026 insight; else PLATFORM ONLY uplift if 2026 insight >10000 else PLATFORM & INSIGHT uplift

platformRenewalUplifts.meaning: Renewal platform pitch = 2026 platform price * (1+uplift*multiplier), round to nearest 100. firm-rates.json already contains fully computed tier prices; this table is reference only.

platformNbFormula.formula: NB platform = base(guide, 2027 dep rankings) * (1 + 0.05 + researchTierPct + productUpliftPct) * 1.08 * 1.07 * 1.05 * (1+stateUplift) * 1.05, round to nearest 100
platformNbFormula.note: firm-rates.json field nb already contains this price for listed firms (excluding state uplift, unrounded integer): final pitch = round(nb*(1+stateUplift), nearest 100). Use this formula + baseRateCard for firms not listed.

discountPolicy.baseRateCardNote: Platform base rate by guide x no of ranked departments; breakpoints [fromDep, rate] apply until next breakpoint. Workbook also derives rate incl. +5%/+2% = rate*1.07.

analyticsRateCard.note: FY27 Analytics rate card by 2027 submission bucket x insight ACT bucket; the calculator prices Analytics from the per-firm PRACTICE ANALYTICS RATE CARD (firm-rates field an; 0 = not eligible).

marketPulse.note: Market Pulse standard price by segment bucket (WORKINGS C36). MIN = 80% of standard (not offered in PLATFORM & MP bundle), MAX = 120%. NB rep/manager: country-band % off pitch.

bundleRulesNote: RULES sheet; merged region cells forward-filled. Sheet note: "SUGGESTIONS: RENEWALS WE PROPOSE 20% LEVER when applying disc or max vs % country disc on new business". Regions present: EUROPE, GREATER CHINA REGION, ASIA-PACIFIC only.
